turns.text:
No — this prediction cannot support an ordering decision for comp1, and I would not place one on it.

The warning adequacy for comp1 is insufficient against both of its parts: the model's measured detection lead is about 24 hours, while PN-COMP1-001 has a 10-day supplier lead time and PN-COMP1-002 has 17 days. By the time the score crosses its threshold the part would arrive long after the failure.

The risk figure itself also needs a caveat: comp1's probability is not calibrated — its held-out Brier skill is not established as better than simply reporting the base rate, so treat it as a ranking signal rather than a likelihood.

What I can tell you is the stock position, which does not depend on the prediction at all. Reordering here should run off stock cover and consumption rate.
